claims.statement: Djedefre ruled after Khufu and before Khafre, during Egypt’s Fourth Dynasty. The Met dates his reign to approximately 2528–2520 BCE.

evidence.locator: Dynasty 4 heading and ordered ruler list
evidence.note: Approximate chronology and succession follow the Met’s Dynasty 4 list.
